+// signatureValid reports whether a thinking block's signature is acceptable: a nonempty string
+// everywhere; on an external endpoint also an absent or empty one (unsigned thinking). A present
+// non-string value is never valid.
+func (s *messageState) signatureValid(b map[string]any) bool {
+	v, has := b["signature"]
+	if !has {
+		return s.external
+	}
+	sig, ok := v.(string)
+	return ok && (sig != "" || s.external)
+}
+
 func blockTypesValue(v any) bool { s, ok := v.(string); return ok && blockTypes[s] }
